name: Internet Monitoring (Geerlingguy)
what_it_is: A Docker Compose stack that runs Prometheus, Grafana, blackbox-exporter, speedtest-exporter, and node-exporter to monitor home internet reliability and throughput. The repository is archived; its contents have been merged into the geerlingguy/internet-pi project.
components: speedtest-exporter by MiguelNdeCarvalho (Ookla speedtest scraping, exposed on :9798)
protocols: TCP (tcp_connect, pop3s_banner, ssh_banner, irc_banner blackbox modules)
measurement: HTTP probe status codes and latency (probe_http_status_code)
Internet download/upload speed and latency via Ookla speedtest (scraped every 30 minutes)
Host system metrics via node-exporter (CPU, memory, disk, filesystem)
Ping/reachability of configurable target URLs with humanname, routing, and switching labels
configuration: Ping targets defined in prometheus/pinghosts.yaml using format url;humanname;routing;switch
Speedtest scrape interval set in prometheus/prometheus.yml under the speedtest job (default 30m)
Global Prometheus scrape interval defaults to 15s; ping job overrides to 5s
Grafana credentials stored in grafana/config.monitoring env file (default user: admin, password: wonka)
Blackbox prober modules defined in blackbox/config/blackbox.yml
modes: Default mode: HTTP 2xx probing for external targets (Google, GitHub, Apple)
Optional local network probing (commented-out targets in pinghosts.yaml)
Optional Shelly smart-plug power monitoring (requires internet-pi companion config)
Optional Starlink dish monitoring (requires internet-pi companion config)
constraints: Repository is archived; no new development occurs here — active development is in geerlingguy/internet-pi
No authentication or TLS on Grafana or Prometheus endpoints — intended for non-public/home networks only
Speedtest scrape_timeout is 60s and each run consumes real bandwidth — default 30m interval may be too frequent on capped connections
Prometheus image is pinned to v2.25.2 (released ~2021); Grafana image is unpinned (latest)
notable_absences: No DNS-specific probing job (DNS protocol listed in project description but no dns blackbox module is configured in the active prometheus.yml)
No alerting configuration wired up (alert.rules file referenced but not included in repo)
No authentication or reverse-proxy setup provided
No IPv6 probing (blackbox http_2xx module forces ip4)
